tagline.en: From the steps of the Executive Yuan round the east coast to Fenggang, by four roads joined under one number
tagline.zh: 自行政院门前出发，绕经东部至枫港，由四条公路接成一个编号

start.en: Zhongshan South Road at Zhongxiao East Road, outside the Executive Yuan in Taipei — the zero point of Taiwan's highways
start.zh: 台北市中正区中山南路与忠孝东路口，行政院大门前——台湾公路原点

end.en: Fenggang, Fangshan, Pingtung, where it meets Provincial Highway 1
end.zh: 屏东县枋山乡枫港，衔接台 1 线

en: Provincial Highway 9 is the trunk road of eastern Taiwan, 446.020 km from central Taipei to Fenggang near the island's southern tip. With Highway 1 on the west it makes the round-the-island road. It is the second-longest highway in the provincial system, after Highway 1; it was the longest from 1978 until the Suhua and South Link improvements cut more than 20 km from it.

It is four historic roads in a line. The Beiyi Highway climbs from Xindian over the hills by Pinglin to Toucheng and the Lanyang plain. The Suhua Highway, from Su'ao to Hualien, follows the cliffs of the east coast. The Hualien–Taitung road runs down the Huadong Rift Valley, and includes the 14.5 km straight between Degao in Guanshan and Wuling in Luye, the longest in Taiwan. The South Link Highway crosses the southern end of the Central Mountain Range from Taitung to Fenggang, highest at Shouka, about 478 m.

Its numbering keeps changing as the road is improved: in January 2026 the Executive Yuan swapped the main line and Highway 9B around Taitung city, so that the main line now runs direct from Binlang to Fengtian and the old route through Malan is Highway 9B.
zh: 台 9 线是台湾东部的干线公路，自台北市中心至岛屿南端附近的枫港，全长 446.020 公里，与西部的台 1 线大致构成环岛公路网。它是省道系统中仅次于台 1 线的第二长公路；1978 年起曾是最长的一条，直到苏花改、南回改等工程使它缩短了 20 余公里。
它由四条历史公路连成。北宜公路自新店翻越坪林一带山区至头城与兰阳平原；苏花公路自苏澳至花莲，沿东海岸峭壁而行；花东纵谷公路沿花东纵谷南下，其中关山德高至鹿野武陵的 14.5 公里是全台最长的直线公路；南回公路自台东越过中央山脉南端至枫港，最高点寿峠海拔约 478 米。
随着道路改善，路线编号也不断调整：2026 年 1 月，行政院将台东市一带的台 9 线主线与台 9 乙线互换，主线改由宾朗直达丰田，原经马兰的路段编入台 9 乙线。

en: The Suhua road is the oldest piece. In 1874, after the Mudan incident, the Qing commissioner Shen Baozhen had Luo Dachun build a mountain road from Su'ao south down the coast, the so-called Northern Road; within eighteen months of completion its garrisons were withdrawn and it was left to decay. The Japanese rebuilt it as a footpath and then as the Linhai (Coastal) Road, 3.56 m wide on the cliffs, with nine large bridges and fourteen tunnels, opened throughout in 1932.

After 1945 it was renamed the Suhua Highway. At its narrowest it was 3.5 m wide with 15 m bends, so traffic ran one way at a time in convoys between six control stations. Widening began in the 1980s and two-way traffic was allowed from 25 October 1990.

The South Link was also Japanese: begun in 1933 and opened in 1939 between Fenggang and Taitung. After Typhoon Haitang washed out the Fenggang River bridge in July 2005, cutting the Hengchun peninsula off, a bypass north of Fenggang was built and finished in 2008.
zh: 苏花段是其中最古老的一段。1874 年牡丹社事件后，清廷钦差大臣沈葆桢派罗大春修筑自苏澳沿海岸南下的山路，即所谓「北路」，完工后不及一年半即撤走驻防，任其废弃。日人先将其整修为步道，再拓为临海道路：峭壁路段宽 3.56 米，有大型桥梁 9 座、隧道 14 处，1932 年全线通车。
1945 年后改称苏花公路。最窄处仅 3.5 米，弯道最小半径 15 米，只能单线双向通车，车辆须在六处管制站之间分批放行。1980 年代开始逐步拓宽，1990 年 10 月 25 日开放双向通车。
南回公路同样始建于日治时期：1933 年兴工，1939 年完成枫港至台东间。2005 年 7 月海棠台风冲断枫港溪桥，恒春半岛对外交通一度中断，其后兴建枫港溪北侧的外环道，2008 年完工。

en: The Suhua improvement, formally the Highway 9 Suhua mountain section improvement plan, rebuilt the three worst stretches between Su'ao and Daqingshui — Su'ao–Dong'ao, Nan'ao–Heping and Hezhong–Daqingshui — as 38.8 km of new two-lane road, mostly tunnel and bridge: eight tunnels totalling 24.5 km, 8.5 km of bridges and 5.8 km at grade. The Guanyin and Gufeng tunnels together run about 12.7 km. It was built to make the coast road safe and reliable, not to carry more traffic.

It was hard going. The Gufeng tunnel, already holed through, suffered a large collapse on 21 October 2017 that buried both bores, and had to be dug through again. In 2016 the rescue excavation of the Hanben archaeological site on the Nan'ao–Heping line was paused after major finds, and calls to preserve the site put that section's schedule at risk.

The South Link improvement widened and straightened the road from Xianglan to Duoliang with the new Jinlun viaduct, and replaced the worst mountain stretch, Anshuo to Caopu, with the Anshuo viaduct and the 4.6 km Caopu tunnel under Qiluzhike Mountain, cutting that section from 15.7 km to 11 km.
zh: 苏花改正式名称为「台 9 线苏花公路山区路段改善计划」，改建苏澳至大清水之间最危险的三段——苏澳—东澳、南澳—和平、和中—大清水——新建双车道道路 38.8 公里，以隧道与桥梁为主：隧道 8 座共 24.5 公里，桥梁 8.5 公里，平面道路 5.8 公里。观音与谷风两座隧道合计约 12.7 公里。计划目标是提升苏花公路的安全性与可靠度，而非提升运输量。
工程并不顺利。已经贯通的谷风隧道于 2017 年 10 月 21 日发生大规模抽崩，双向均遭土石掩埋，只得重新开挖。2016 年，南澳—和平段的汉本遗址因发现重要遗迹而暂停抢救发掘，民间团体要求现地保留，使该段完工时程受到威胁。
南回改则拓宽并截弯取直香兰至多良段，新建金仑高架桥；最险峻的安朔至草埔山区段改为新线，以安朔高架桥与贯穿耆鹿知可山、长 4.6 公里的草埔隧道取代，该段里程由 15.7 公里缩短为 11 公里。

en: The Suhua plan was approved in December 2010 at an estimated NT$49.2 billion, to be met from the central government's public works budget, and ended at NT$55.173 billion. The South Link plan was approved in July 2011 at NT$19.039 billion and ended at NT$22.749 billion.

The gaps left in the Suhua improvement — Dong'ao–Nan'ao, Heping–Hezhong and Heren–Chongde — form a further project, the Suhua Highway safety enhancement plan, 29.9 km long, which passed its environmental review in 2024; the transport ministry has put its cost at about NT$82 billion.
zh: 苏花改 2010 年 12 月经经建会通过，概估经费 492 亿元，由中央编列公务预算支应，最终总经费为 551.73 亿元。南回改 2011 年 7 月经行政院核定，总经费 190.39 亿元，最终为 227.49 亿元。
苏花改未涵盖的东澳—南澳、和平—和中、和仁—崇德三段，另立为「苏花公路安全提升计划」（苏花安），规划长度约 29.9 公里，2024 年通过环境影响评估；交通部估计经费约 820 亿元。

en: Limits are 30 to 70 km/h. The improved Suhua sections have a 70 km/h limit with a 50 km/h minimum (Renshui tunnel 60), and are among the very few provincial highway sections where motorcycles are barred, except heavy motorcycles, allowed since September 2022, and the Renshui tunnel. Between the new sections the road reverts to the old coast road, and the old line itself survives as Highway 9D.
The South Link opening in December 2019 cut about 30 minutes from Taitung to Fenggang, according to the engineering office.
zh: 速限为每小时 30 至 70 公里。苏花改路段最高速限 70 公里、最低 50 公里（仁水隧道 60 公里），是台湾一般省道中极少数禁止机车行驶的路段，唯大型重型机车自 2022 年 9 月起可通行，仁水隧道亦开放机车。新路段之间仍接回旧苏花公路，旧线则保留为台 9 丁线。
据工程处表示，2019 年 12 月南回改通车后，台东至枫港车程缩短约 30 分钟。

why.en: Highway 9 was assembled from roads built between 1874 and the 1990s by the Qing, the Japanese and the provincial highway bureau; there is no cost for the route as a whole. The two recent rebuilds are given below.
why.zh: 台 9 线由清代、日治时期及省公路局自 1874 年至 1990 年代陆续修筑的多条公路连成，没有整条路线的造价。近年的两项改建工程列于下方。

timeline.en: Qing troops cut the Northern Road down the coast from Su'ao after the Mudan incident.
timeline.zh: 牡丹社事件后，清军自苏澳沿海岸开辟北路。

timeline.en: The Japanese Linhai Road, the future Suhua Highway, opens throughout.
timeline.zh: 日治时期的临海道路（日后的苏花公路）全线通车。

timeline.en: The Fenggang–Taitung road, the future South Link, is completed.
timeline.zh: 枫港至台东道路（日后的南回公路）完成。

timeline.en: Two-way traffic is allowed along the whole Suhua Highway from 25 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 25 日，苏花公路全线开放双向通车。

timeline.en: Typhoon Haitang washes out the Fenggang River bridge in July.
timeline.zh: 7 月，海棠台风冲断枫港溪桥。

timeline.en: A tour coach accident on the Suhua Highway on 21 October hastens the improvement plan, which passes its environmental review on 9 November.
timeline.zh: 10 月 21 日苏花公路游览车事故后，苏花改加速推动，11 月 9 日有条件通过环评。

timeline.en: Work on the Suhua improvement starts on 29 January.
The Gufeng tunnel collapses on 21 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 21 日，谷风隧道发生大规模抽崩。

timeline.en: The first improved Suhua section, Su'ao to Dong'ao, opens on 5 February.
timeline.zh: 2 月 5 日，苏花改苏澳—东澳段通车。

timeline.en: The South Link improvement opens: Jinlun–Daniao on 28 October, the Caopu tunnel and Anshuo viaduct on 23 December.
timeline.zh: 南回改通车：10 月 28 日金仑—大鸟段，12 月 23 日草埔隧道与安朔高架桥。

timeline.en: The rest of the Suhua improvement opens on 6 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 6 日，苏花改其余路段通车。

timeline.en: The main line and Highway 9B around Taitung are swapped on 12 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 12 日，台东一带台 9 线主线与台 9 乙线互换。
